description: Connect EZR omnichannel CRM to bring member, sales, campaign, WeCom operation, coupon analytics, mall operation, audience segmentation, and MA canvas monitoring capabilities into agents for natural-language business queries and operational insights.

display.description_en: Connect EZR omnichannel CRM to bring member, sales, campaign, WeCom operation, coupon analytics, mall operation, audience segmentation, and MA canvas monitoring capabilities into agents for natural-language business queries and operational insights.
display.description_zh: 连接 EZR 全域 CRM，把会员、销售、活动、企微运营、券分析、商城运营、人群圈选和 MA 画布监控等能力带入智能体，帮助品牌用自然语言完成经营查询、运营分析和策略洞察。
examples_en: Show me member recruitment in the last 30 days
Analyze this month's omnichannel sales performance across offline, Tmall, and Douyin channels
Review recent mall operation performance and changes in product visits, add-to-cart, and sales rankings
Analyze the claim, redemption, and conversion performance of this coupon campaign
Segment members in Shanghai who purchased in the last 90 days
Review WeCom customer assets and mass-send touch performance
Review the performance of running MA canvases in the last month
examples_zh: 帮我看一下最近 30 天会员招募情况
分析一下本月全域销售表现，线下、天猫和抖音渠道分别贡献多少
最近商城运营表现怎么样，商品访问、加购和成交排行有什么变化
帮我分析这个券活动的领取、核销和转化效果
圈选近 90 天有消费且在上海的会员
看一下企微客户资产和群发触达效果
查看最近一个月进行中的 MA 画布效果
